remarks: Modern Loft Living in the Heart of SONO. Experience the epitome of urban convenience in this stylish 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo nestled in vibrant downtown SONO. This rare designer apartment boasts an open-concept living space, hardwood floors and vaulted ceilings with a full sun-filled South West corner exposure. Enjoy new high-end stainless appliances in your resurfaced kitchen with new glass tile backsplash, custom spice & pull out drawers, black hardware and quartz countertops. Large bedroom offers a custom suited walk-in closet. Closets by Design and custom bamboo shades throughout apartment. Immaculate full bathroom is complete with modern fixtures and bathtub. Convenient ladder to large loft for extra sleeping, office and/or storage. Highly efficient new hydro gas furnace, AC and smart eco b thermostat ensure low heating bills perfect for those seeking a low-maintenance lifestyle without sacrificing style or comfort. Pet friendly. A wonderful small and private community of only 12 units. Large elevator services the 3 floors to lower parking garage and industrial user friendly app controlled washer/dryers. Assigned parking spot in garage with private resident only entrance. Quick walk to Metro North, SONO Collection Mall and the best South Norwalk restaurants and nightlife. Easy on 95 and quick drive to Calfs pasture beach.
